title: SEBI Replaces ₹10 Lakh Annual Custodian Fee with ₹85,000 Monthly Fee Mechanism
summary: Amends Custodian Regulations to charge ₹85,000/month or 0.0000416% Assets Under Custody.

blocks.content: Amends Custodian Regulations to charge ₹85,000/month or 0.0000416% Assets Under Custody.

items: Revised Fee Formula: Custodians will pay ₹85,000/month or 0.0000416% AUC (whichever higher) effective October 1, 2026.
Previous Fee Structure: Replaces annual fee of ₹10 lakh or 0.0005% AUC.
Payment Schedule: Monthly fee must be remitted within 15 days of month-end.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: SEBI received ₹175.80 crore in custodian fees in FY26.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Monthly custodian fee (₹85,000 / 0.0000416% AUC) vs previous annual fee (₹10 lakh / 0.0005% AUC).
